Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
utils.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Static façade that manages all JavaFX scene-root swaps and in-game UI updates.

SceneManager acts as the View layer in an MVC-like structure. GameManager never touches JavaFX nodes directly; instead it calls static methods on SceneManager which delegate to the appropriate JavaFX UI components.

Initialisation

Before any method can be used, two one-time registration calls must be made:

  1. setInitialScene(javafx.scene.Scene, javafx.scene.layout.StackPane, javafx.scene.Parent, javafx.scene.Parent, javafx.scene.Parent, javafx.scene.Parent, javafx.scene.Parent, javafx.scene.Parent) — registers the primary Scene and all non-game Parent roots (menu, character-select, settings, …).
  2. setInitialGameLayout(gui.gameLayout.BackpackPanel, gui.gameLayout.LevelPanel, javafx.scene.Parent, gui.gameLayout.WeaponAndAccessoryPanel, gui.gameLayout.TopPanel, javafx.scene.Parent, gui.gameLayout.LevelUpChoice, gui.gameLayout.ChestChoice) — registers the in-game overlay panels (backpack, top bar, level progress, weapon/accessory grid, …).

Thread safety

All methods must be called on the JavaFX Application Thread.
